faq_heading: Homes near White Rock Christian Academy: your questions answered

faq.q: Does living near White Rock Christian Academy get a child a place?
faq.a: No. White Rock Christian Academy is an independent school and sets its own admission, so distance does not decide it. Ask the school how applications and wait lists work.

faq.q: How does the White Rock Christian Academy home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names White Rock Christian Academy, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to White Rock Christian Academy?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Star of the Sea (0.4 km north-west), Jessie Lee Elementary (0.6 km south-east) and Newbridge Academy (0.7 km south).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of White Rock Christian Academy

17 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of White Rock Christian Academy in a straight line (12 elementary, 3 secondary, 2 other; 4 independent). The closest is Star of the Sea, 0.4 km away, and the farthest on this list is Edgewood Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Semiahmoo Secondary (1.2 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Jessie Lee Elementary (0.6 km). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-12) is Southridge School, 1.8 km north-east of White Rock Christian Academy.
